title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: Russia promises diesel will reach US ports
preheader: Italy's PM calls the deal 'very risky' as Congress questions its legality.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Thursday, October 15, 2026 — the 3 stories that matter most today, plus 3 updates on stories you're following and 5 quick items from around the world.

stories.story_title: Moscow says Trump's diesel waiver will send Russian fuel to the US
stories.why_important: President Trump suspended the ban on Russian diesel exports last week. On Wednesday, Russia's deputy prime minister, Alexander Novak, said direct shipments to the United States will follow, starting with more than 300,000 tonnes. The waiver conflicts with a 2022 law Congress passed to ban Russian fuel imports.
stories.what_overlooked: Foreign Policy notes the deal has no clear legal basis. Trump signed tougher sanctions on Russian energy less than a month before offering the waiver.
stories.prediction: A court or Congress could challenge the waiver within days; a legal filing would show whether the shipments can legally begin.

stories.story_title: Ukraine resumes refinery strikes after Zelensky says the pause is over
stories.why_important: Zelensky told the Financial Times that Ukraine is done holding back on Russian oil refineries. A strike in Russia's Ryazan region followed on Thursday. Refinery attacks are how Kyiv squeezes the oil revenue that funds Russia's war.
stories.what_overlooked: Zelensky also said in the interview that the US has reduced intelligence sharing with Kyiv, which he called dangerous for Ukraine's defenses.
stories.prediction: Whether Ukraine hits more refineries in the next 72 hours will show if Trump's energy ceasefire has effectively collapsed.

stories.story_title: US military weighs 'mother of all bombs' for strikes on Iran, CNN reports
stories.why_important: CNN reported Thursday that US military planners have drawn up options against Iranian energy and nuclear sites. Those options include the GBU-43/B, the largest non-nuclear bomb in the US arsenal. Trump would have to order renewed combat for any strike to happen.
stories.what_overlooked: The options come from unnamed US officials, and no order has been announced. It is unclear whether this is a real plan or a message to Tehran.
stories.prediction: Whether Trump repeats the threat or US bombers reposition in the next few days will show if the plan is more than a message.

quick_hits.text: Police fired water cannons and tear gas in Tirana as protesters set the justice ministry on fire and demanded Prime Minister Edi Rama resign.
An Indian court jailed two leaders of the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party for five days after protests against the election commission's voter-roll purge.
The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV is out of bed and recovering normally after surgeons removed the lower part of his right lung.
President Trump told a campaign rally that people who leak government information should be shot, ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
Ukraine said SpaceX restored Starlink service for fast-moving terminals after Kyiv complained; Elon Musk said Starshield is owned by the US government.

big_number.context: Russia's Pacific Fleet said a nuclear submarine fired cruise missiles at a target 1,200 km away in a Pacific drill, Al Jazeera reported.

views.framing: Western media treats Trump’s diesel waiver as legally and politically contested, stressing U.S. sanctions law and Ukraine.
views.quote: The administration’s surprise suspension of bans on Russian diesel exports, announced on Friday, faces legal and political challenges, as many lawmakers have noted .

views.framing: Russian state media frames the diesel deal as an economic win that could weaken sanctions and protect Russian exports.
Russian exile media frames Moscow’s diesel-deal praise as self-serving, stressing direct U.S. exports and reliance on state-run TASS.
views.quote: A diesel supply deal with the United States will boost Russia’s economy and include direct exports to the U.S. market, Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said Wednesday.

perspective_grid.blindspot: Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in the occupied West Bank village of Mikhmas, Palestinian sources and the Israeli military said. The attack risks inflaming Israeli-Palestinian tensions and regional instability.

signals.text: Polymarket puts "Will Trump acquire Greenland before 2027?" at 2%.

developing.text: A commercial ship caught fire in Romania's Black Sea waters, and authorities are checking whether drones caused it in the latest attack on shipping there.
Oman's foreign minister met Pakistan's prime minister in Islamabad and praised Pakistan's push to calm the region after US-Israeli strikes on Iran.
Japan's prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, said the spying charges against a detained Hokkaido Shimbun reporter in Russia are unclear, and Tokyo denies spying.
